<!--
Version of cod-icf-deaths-firstpass.qmd for sharing outside the team.
No ownership-group comparisons, and no names shown.
death_id is kept as a hidden column so a death can be traced back if it's questioned;
it isn't displayed, but it is in the page source.
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup

pacman::p_load("tidyverse", "lubridate", "janitor", "here", "glue", "gt", "reactable", "reactablefmtr")
invisible(here::i_am("death-certificates/cod-icf-deaths-review.qmd"))

```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

level_labels <- c (
  "3" = "3 Further review",
  "2" = "2 Vigilance",
  "1" = "1 Expected (chronic disease)",
  "0" = "0 Baseline (lifelong condition)"
)

deaths <-
  readRDS ( here ( "death-certificates/cod-deaths-coded.RDS")) |>
  mutate (
    # government deaths have no facility name; use the owner
    `Facility Name` = if_else ( df_source == "Gov", "North Carolina", `Facility Name`),
    death_date = ymd ( str_sub ( death_id, 1, 8)),
    level = factor ( level_labels[as.character ( max_level)], levels = level_labels),
    age   = as.numeric ( ymd ( str_sub ( death_id, 1, 8)) - ymd ( str_sub ( death_id, -8))) / 365.25
  )

causes <-
  readRDS ( here ( "death-certificates/cod-causes-coded.RDS"))

```

## Death overview

```{r}
#| label: overview-table

deaths |>
  summarise (
    deaths     = n(),
    facilities = n_distinct ( `Facility Name`),
    median_age = median ( age),
    natural    = sum ( manner == "Natural"),
    accident   = sum ( manner == "Accident"),
    homicide   = sum ( manner == "Homicide"),
    other      = sum ( manner %in% c ( "Pending", "Could Not Be Determined")),
    autopsy    = sum ( autop == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    autopsy_pct = autopsy / deaths
  ) |>
  gt () |>
  fmt_number ( median_age, decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_percent ( autopsy_pct, decimals = 0) |>
  cols_merge ( c ( autopsy, autopsy_pct), pattern = "{1} ({2})") |>
  tab_spanner ( "Manner of death", c ( natural, accident, homicide, other)) |>
  cols_label (
    deaths = "Deaths", facilities = "Facilities", median_age = "Median age at death",
    natural = "Natural", accident = "Accident", homicide = "Homicide",
    other = "Pending or undetermined", autopsy = "Autopsy"
  ) |>
  tab_source_note ( glue ( "Autopsy status was not recorded for {sum(is.na(deaths$autop))} deaths."))

```

## How serious were the causes listed?

Each death is placed at the highest level among all of the causes on its record. The levels flag records for a closer look; they are not findings of neglect.

- **3 Review further** sometimes linked to lapses in supervision, feeding, hydration, skin care or safety (choking, falls, dehydration, bedsores)
- **2 Vigilance:** good monitoring and timely treatment could change the outcome (sepsis, pneumonia, seizures)
- **1 Expected:** chronic disease, cancer or end-of-life decline
- **0 Baseline:** only the person's lifelong disability is listed

```{r}
#| label: level-table

deaths |>
  tabyl ( level) |>
  adorn_totals ( "row") |>
  adorn_pct_formatting ( digits = 0) |>
  gt ( rowname_col = "level") |>
  cols_label ( n = "Deaths", percent = "Share") |>
  tab_style ( cell_text ( weight = "bold"), cells_body ( rows = level == "Total")) |>
  tab_style ( cell_text ( weight = "bold"), cells_stub ( rows = level == "Total")) |>
  tab_header ( "Deaths by highest level")

```

## Deaths calling for further review

Every death with at least one level 3 cause. Search across all columns with the box at the top, filter within a column with the boxes under the headers, or click a header to sort. Click the arrow at the left of a row to see every cause listed on that death, in the order it appears on the death certificate.

```{r}
#| label: level-3-table

level_3_ids <- deaths |> filter ( max_level == 3) |> pull ( death_id)

review_areas <-
  causes |>
  filter ( sentinel_level == 3) |>
  group_by ( death_id) |>
  summarise ( review_areas = paste ( unique ( care_focus_area), collapse = "; "))

uc_labels <-
  readRDS ( here ( "death-certificates/cod_sentinel_coding.RDS")) |>
  select ( uc = code, uc_label = short_label)

level_3 <-
  deaths |>
  filter ( death_id %in% level_3_ids) |>
  left_join ( review_areas, join_by ( death_id)) |>
  left_join ( uc_labels, join_by ( uc)) |>
  arrange ( desc ( death_date)) |>
  # official cause first, right beside the expand arrow; death_id last (hidden in the table)
  select ( uc_label, `Facility Name`, death_date, age, manner, autop,
           top_labels, review_areas, death_id)

# every cause on each death, in record-axis order (the order on the certificate), for the expandable rows
level_3_causes <-
  causes |>
  filter ( death_id %in% level_3_ids) |>
  arrange ( death_id, order) |>
  select ( death_id, rac, short_label, sentinel_level, care_focus_area) |>
  split ( ~ death_id)

level_3_table <- reactable (
  level_3,
  theme = nytimes ( font_size = 13, header_font_size = 11, cell_padding = 6),
  class = "nyt-table",
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  wrap = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  defaultColDef = colDef ( headerVAlign = "bottom", vAlign = "top"),
  columns = list (
    uc_label         = colDef ( name = "ACME UC", minWidth = 140, style = list ( fontWeight = 600)),
    `Facility Name`  = colDef ( name = "Facility", minWidth = 140),
    death_date       = colDef ( name = "Date of death", format = colFormat ( date = TRUE), minWidth = 90),
    age              = colDef ( name = "Age", format = colFormat ( digits = 0), minWidth = 55, align = "right", filterable = FALSE),
    manner           = colDef ( name = "Manner", minWidth = 80),
    autop            = colDef ( name = "Autopsy", minWidth = 70),
    top_labels       = colDef ( name = "Level 3 causes", minWidth = 180),
    review_areas     = colDef ( name = "Level 3 care areas", minWidth = 150),
    # kept for tracing a death back; not displayed
    death_id         = colDef ( show = FALSE)
  ),
  details = function ( index) {
    level_3_causes[[level_3$death_id[index]]] |>
      select ( -death_id) |>
      reactable (
        theme = nytimes ( font_size = 12, header_font_size = 10, cell_padding = 4),
        fullWidth = FALSE,
        # show every cause; paging hides the ones past 10
        pagination = FALSE,
        columns = list (
          rac             = colDef ( name = "Code", width = 70),
          short_label     = colDef ( name = "Cause", width = 260),
          sentinel_level  = colDef ( name = "Level", width = 60, align = "right"),
          care_focus_area = colDef ( name = "Care area", width = 200)
        )
      )
  }
)

# plain divs rather than add_title(), which makes h1/h2 tags that pick up the page's heading styles
htmltools::div (
  class = "nyt-wrap",
  htmltools::div ( class = "nyt-title", "Deaths with at least one cause to review"),
  htmltools::div ( class = "nyt-subtitle",
    glue ( "{nrow(level_3)} deaths in North Carolina ICFs, {year(min(deaths$death_date))} to {year(max(deaths$death_date))}")),
  level_3_table,
  htmltools::div ( class = "nyt-source", "Source: N.C. death certificate records; cause-of-death levels assigned by the project team.")
)

```

## Coding of causes of death 




```{r}
cods <- readRDS(here("death-certificates/cod_sentinel_coding.RDS"))


cods |>   
  mutate ( printed_levels  = factor( sentinel_level, 
                                    levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3), 
                                    labels = c("0 - Baseline", "1 - Expected", "2 - Requires vigilence", "3 - Review further"), 
                                    ordered = TRUE )
  ) |> 
  select ( - sentinel_level) |> 
  arrange ( desc( printed_levels)) |> 
  reactable (
    theme = nytimes ( font_size = 13, header_font_size = 11, cell_padding = 6),
    class = "nyt-table",
    searchable = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    wrap = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
    defaultColDef = colDef ( headerVAlign = "bottom", vAlign = "top"), 
    columns = list (
            code             = colDef ( name = "Code", width = 70),
            description     = colDef( name="Description", width = 200),
            short_label     = colDef ( name = "Short label", width = 150),
            plain_language_definition = colDef(name= "Plain language definition", width=260),
            sentinel_level  = colDef ( name = "Level", width = 60, align = "right"),
            care_focus_area = colDef ( name = "Care area", width = 150)
    )
)


```

::: {.nyt-source}

Code descriptions come from NCHS translations where possible, ICD-10s where they didn't exist. Coding of short labels, plain language descriptions and review level performed with the help of Claude Code by the project team. 

:::
